title: Export broken
text: Every month the export of reports to Excel fails and I lose an afternoon rebuilding the close in a spreadsheet.
author: Alice Tremblay

text: The report export to Excel times out for our monthly close, so we copy and paste everything by hand. I would pay for a fix.
author: Bob

text: Le prix de l'abonnement est beaucoup trop élevé pour une petite firme comptable comme la nôtre, et nous cherchons une autre solution.
author: Chantal

text: There is no French interface and our Québec staff struggle with the English screens every single day.
author: Denis
